description: A string template can't give the labels property its labels, even one giving a tuple
notes: The documentation of Expand says the labels attribute is evaluated, which a template giving a tuple of labels would allow. hashicorp/hcl requires a static list, which the JSON spec only allows as an array (hcl.ExprList in expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: A static list expression is required
